programs.name: sucvs4fowler
programs.purpose: Compute constant-velocity stacks for Fowler processing.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUCVS4FOWLER --compute constant velocity stacks for input to Fowler codes

params.name: ncdps
params.description: Number of input CDP gathers to process.

params.name: vminstack
params.description: Minimum stacking velocity in meters per second.

params.name: nvstack
params.description: Number of velocity panels.

params.name: lmute
params.description: Mute taper length in milliseconds; converted to output samples.

params.name: nonhyp
params.description: Enable the nonhyperbolic moveout mute.

params.name: vhyp
params.description: Velocity used by the nonhyperbolic mute.

params.name: lbtaper
params.description: Bottom taper length in milliseconds.

params.name: lstaper
params.description: Side taper length in CDP gathers.

params.name: dtout
params.default: computed: 1.5 times input header dt in seconds
params.description: Output sample interval in seconds.

params.name: mxfold
params.description: Maximum input traces per CDP gather.

params.name: salias
params.description: Antialias frequency fraction; values above 1 are capped at 1.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Uses float accumulation, square roots, cosine tapers and eight-point sinc interpolation. The output trace header is uninitialized except for ns, dt, cdp and tracf. The fold limit is checked after writing to the arrays, so an oversized gather can write out of bounds; mute indices can also be out of range.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers gathers and performs moveout interpolation and stacking for multiple velocities.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 | sucvs4fowler ncdps=1 nvstack=8 mxfold=16

test_cases.description: Custom sampling, taper and mute settings.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 | sucvs4fowler ncdps=1 nvstack=8 mxfold=16 vminstack=1800 dtout=0.004 nonhyp=0 lmute=8 lbtaper=16 lstaper=1 salias=0.6

programs.name: sudivstack
programs.purpose: Stack adjacent traces using inverse average or peak power weights.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDIVSTACK -  Diversity Stacking using either average power or peak

params.name: key
params.description: Header word identifying adjacent traces to stack.

params.name: winlen
params.default: computed: (ns - 1) times header dt in seconds
params.description: Power window length in seconds; the resulting sample count is capped at ns.

params.name: peak
params.description: Use peak power when nonzero; otherwise use average power.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Power, inverse weights and stack sums accumulate in float, with linear interpolation between windows. The default interval calculation mixes double and float; zero-power samples are skipped.
programs.difficulty_reason: It computes and interpolates windowed weights while stacking adjacent trace groups.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=tracf a=1 | sudivstack key=tracf
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 | sudivstack key=cdp winlen=0.032 peak=1

programs.name: supws
programs.purpose: Compute phase stacks or phase-weighted stacks of adjacent traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPWS - Phase stack or phase-weighted stack (PWS) of adjacent traces

params.name: key
params.description: Header word identifying adjacent traces to stack.

params.name: pwr
params.description: Power applied to phase coherence.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: header dt in microseconds divided by 1000000; 0.004 if the result is zero
params.description: Sampling interval in seconds, used for smoothing.

params.name: sl
params.description: Phase-weight smoothing length in seconds.

params.name: ps
params.description: Output the phase stack instead of the phase-weighted stack when nonzero.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print diagnostics when nonzero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Hilbert transformation, complex magnitude, pow and float accumulation are sensitive to arithmetic and library implementation. Smoothing sums 2*(isl/2) samples but divides by isl, including for odd lengths. Header keys are converted to float before comparison.
programs.difficulty_reason: It computes Hilbert transforms and complex phase coherence across trace groups.

test_cases.description: Phase-weighted stack with custom power and smoothing.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 | supws key=cdp pwr=2 sl=0.016 dt=0.004
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=tracf a=1 | supws key=tracf ps=1 pwr=0.5 verbose=1

programs.name: surecip
programs.purpose: Stack adjacent traces with matching CDP and offset in prepared reciprocal data.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURECIP - sum opposing offsets in prepared data (see below)

params.name: norm
params.description: Divide each stack by its fold when nonzero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Samples are accumulated in input order as floats and optionally divided by fold. The first trace is accessed even when input is empty.
programs.difficulty_reason: It groups adjacent traces by two headers and sums their samples.

test_cases.description: Normalized reciprocal stacks from prepared data.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp,offset a=1,100 b=0,0 | surecip norm=1
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp,offset a=1,100 b=0,10 | surecip norm=0

programs.name: sustack
programs.purpose: Stack adjacent traces with the same header value.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSTACK - stack adjacent traces having the same key header word

params.name: key
params.description: Header word identifying adjacent traces to stack.

params.name: normpow
params.description: Exponent of the nonzero sample count used for normalization.

params.name: repeat
params.description: Repeat each output stack when nonzero.

params.name: nrepeat
params.description: Number of copies when repeat is enabled.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print key values and fold when nonzero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Samples accumulate in input order as floats; normalization uses double-precision pow and converts back to float. Initial fold uses the first trace's nhs when nonzero, while sample normalization counts input traces with nonzero samples. Empty input is accessed without a check.
programs.difficulty_reason: It groups adjacent traces and performs per-sample summation and normalization.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 | sustack key=cdp normpow=1
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=offset a=100 | sustack key=offset normpow=0 repeat=1 nrepeat=3 verbose=1

programs.name: sustackup
programs.purpose: Stack traces in any input order by combinations of header values, with optional range filters.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSTACKUP - Input Any Trace Order and Stack To Any Key Combination.

params.name: keyloc
params.description: Header words defining each output location.

params.name: keyabs
params.description: Header word used for the absolute-value range filter.

params.name: keyabs2
params.description: Header word subtracted from keyabs before taking the absolute value; requires keyabs.

params.name: minabs
params.description: Lower absolute range limit; requires keyabs.

params.name: maxabs
params.description: Upper absolute range limit; requires keyabs.

params.name: keysign
params.description: Header word used for the signed range filter.

params.name: keysign2
params.description: Header word subtracted from keysign; requires keysign.

params.name: minsign
params.description: Lower signed range limit; requires keysign.

params.name: maxsign
params.description: Upper signed range limit; requires keysign.

params.name: keep
params.description: Keep output locations with no traces passing the filters.

params.name: maxstack
params.description: Maximum number of distinct output locations.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Amplitudes are accumulated in double and divided by sample fold stored as float, then converted to float. Header keys are compared as doubles. abs on the most negative integer offset has undefined behavior. Inserting a new location shifts one pointer beyond the used range, which writes beyond the allocation when the location count reaches maxstack.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers and sorts arbitrary combinations of trace headers while filtering and stacking samples.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 j=2 | sustackup keyloc=cdp maxstack=16

test_cases.description: Combined location keys and absolute and signed range filters.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp,offset a=1,-30 b=0,10 | sustackup keyloc=cdp,offset keyabs=offset minabs=10 maxabs=40 keysign=offset minsign=-20 maxsign=30 keep=0 maxstack=16

test_cases.description: Difference-based filtering and retained empty locations.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp,offset a=1,10 b=1,10 | sustackup keyloc=cdp keyabs=offset keyabs2=cdp minabs=100 maxabs=200 keep=1 maxstack=16
